extraReviewerInstructions: Files under eval/cases/ are evaluation fixtures for the reviewer itself. Instead check that each fixture really demonstrates what its case.json title and findings describe, that each case.json "near" string appears in the file it names, and that every case with "expect": "clean" contains no real defect.
